paper_metadata.title: Plasma assisted nitriding of Ni-based superalloys with various microstructures

evidence.quote: Plasma assisted nitriding of various Ni-based superalloys, either polycrystals (Haynes®230, Inconel®718, Udimet®720Li, N18) or single crystals (MC2 and MC-NG)
The experimental observations con ﬁrm that the plasma assisted treatment at 400 °C leads to nitrogen incorporation in Ni-based superalloys.
